title: Backflow preventer maintenance: document the assembly and service history
description: Maintenance means preserving a documented, testable assembly and resolving observed defects before they become a failed test or outage.
prompt: What preventive work is appropriate for this exact assembly?
answer: Maintenance means preserving a documented, testable assembly and resolving observed defects before they become a failed test or outage. It is not a reason to adjust internal components without the correct procedure.
urgency: Escalate relief discharge, corrosion that affects the body, freeze damage, impaired shutoffs, or a missing prior test record.
diagramAlt: Backflow service and compliance workflow reference
identifiers: Capture manufacturer, model, nominal size, serial number, and last completed test date.
Record whether the assembly serves irrigation, domestic water, commercial equipment, or another protected connection.
Separate visual housekeeping from work that changes components, test settings, or protection status.

choices.label: I have a notice or program requirement
choices.detail: Use the issuing program to verify deadline and filing requirements.

choices.label: The assembly failed or needs service
choices.detail: Document the device and define repair plus retest scope.

choices.label: I manage a commercial asset
choices.detail: Separate access, shutdown, testing, and closeout responsibilities.

steps.title: Establish the exact record
steps.body: Photograph the label and installation, then keep the last report and approved maintenance history in one record.

steps.title: Define the specific scope
steps.body: Note clearance, corrosion, discharge, missing caps, and freeze exposure without disassembly.

steps.title: Prove the closeout
steps.body: Use the governing testing cadence and confirm whether planned service needs a certified retest or filed result.

safeChecks: Keep relief and vent openings unobstructed.
Do not paint over labels or cover test access.
Use manufacturer instructions for any component-level service.
stopConditions: The body is cracked, distorted, or freeze damaged.
A testable assembly cannot be positively identified.
notThisDevice: A generic service listing does not establish program eligibility.
A device family is not enough to identify compatible parts.
This page does not replace a qualified assessment or authority approval.
evidenceNote: Use the governing utility or authority requirement and exact manufacturer documentation to validate this specific decision path.
